dict.string: O Dexter conecta este app à base do seu Mac e aos aparelhos pareados, quando você solicitar.
To let you explicitly request up to ten event titles and start times in the next 30 days from Dexter's local capability screen.
To let you explicitly request one coordinate rounded to 0.01 degrees while using Dexter; iOS and your settings determine acquisition precision.
To scan your Mac’s private Dexter pairing QR code when you tap Scan, or capture one image when you request it in device capabilities.
To let you explicitly start up to ten seconds of microphone input, kept in memory only, from Dexter's local capability screen.
